definition.text: (Gr. soudarion, John 11:44; 20:7; Lat. sudarium, a “sweat-cloth”), a cloth for wiping the sweat from the face. But the word is used of a wrapper to fold money in (Luke 19:20), and as an article of dress, a “handkerchief” worn on the head (Acts 19:12).

works.title: Ante-Nicene Fathers, Volume 4: Tertullian (Part Fourth), Minucius Felix, Commodian, Origen (Parts First and Second)
